categoryChanges.reason: Choosing a lock-screen design, configuring automatic idle actions and temporarily keeping the computer awake are separate tasks.
Displaying a desktop clock does not establish the ability to compare time zones.
Inspecting running agents and resuming an archived conversation require different controls.
Checks of configured targets are distinct from provider-published incident reports.
General conditions and forecasts are separate from precipitation radar imagery.
Joining a network and sharing an existing connection through a hotspot are separate tasks.
Host port and address rules are distinct from blocking one application's outbound traffic.
